notes: NP_08 s6's cross-house hybrid research as the sim reads it. A Sworn pair (economy.v1.json's Kizuna effect 'hybrid') from two houses, each with a native of his house learned (his house's natives when NATIVE, its SECRET when his secret:<NAME> flag is set, the native his card carries), forges once at a Forge event between duals, paying the ledger's Spirits and Beans (NP_11 s6: both currencies name Forge events as a sink). The output is a hissatsu record (NP_11 s9's schema, hybrid_parents set) unique to the pair: the library's authored hybrid for the two houses when one exists and no pair has claimed it (Two Rivers, Grain & Snow), else one composed from both houses' natives by the rules below. Either fighter of the pair casts it as a T3 (NP_05 s3: CHARGED or bonded adjacency): when he enters CHARGED, when his partner fought the segment before him (relayed between them - the strongest: the partner's afterimage and x1.25), or from an Awakening's hybrid slot (NP_09 s6). Eight per save (the launch ceiling). The Forge scene, its host (NP_10 s7's The Wall) and the Toronto academy's industrialized hybrids (NP_07 s10) are academy.v1.json's syntheses (PAC-092), composed by the same rules on the library's natives.

forge.host: The Wall (NP_10 s7) - a facility the sim does not build
forge.scene: the Forge event's scene is the content lane's; the sim's is its feed line and event
forge.text: first-draft prices: NP_11 s6 pays 3-8 Spirits a spar or dual and 3-10 Beans a training slot - a Forge costs several of each (scarcity keeps each one a saga)

discounts.source: NP_07A Q-NGUYEN-ROY: 'the quest arms the Two Rivers Forge pairing early' and 'Forge discount for E07-pair hybrids'
discounts.text: read: with the questline done, a pair across E07 (Nguyen-Roy x Delacroix-Cardinal) forges at Duo (Lv4), a level early, for half

compose.family: the family of the strongest learned native of either (the most DMG; a WALL never), ARC if neither strikes
compose.dmg: the stronger parent's DMG + 0.1, never under the T3 floor 2.4 (Grain & Snow: Full Load's 2.4 -> 2.5; Two Rivers: 2.4)
compose.tags: from each house, the first non-DMG, non-WALL effect of the fighter's learned natives in the library's order; a state's or a buff's seconds capped at 2 (Grain & Snow: Grain Elevator's guard shred 40, Premiere Neige's auto-slip 5 s -> 2 s)
compose.cinematic: 2100 ms + 100 a tag, as the library's T3s run (Coast to Coast and Two Rivers 2200 with one, Aurora Chain and Grain & Snow 2300 with two)
compose.name: the two houses' motifs in the houses' order (Grain & Snow: Kowalchuk's Grain, Tremblay's Snow); a name already forged by another pair carries the pair's names after it, as an unnamed Duo's does

cast.text: a T3 (NP_05 s3: requires CHARGED or bonded adjacency): live for either of the pair when his partner fought the segment before (relayed between them: the partner's afterimage joins and its damage x1.25 - 'strongest when relayed'), when he enters CHARGED (the relay opens his T3s), or while he is Awakened (NP_09 s6's +1 hybrid slot, the card's choice of his hybrids); it answers its family's motion before a Duo's T3, a relay T3 and the card's own move

motifs.text: first-draft motif words per house, read off each house's natives and root (Kowalchuk's Grain and Tremblay's Snow from Grain & Snow); the content lane's to rewrite; the sealed house has none until it is unsealed
